title: FlappyNouns
tagline: A Nouns-Style FlappyBird-Like Telegram game deployed on Flow that gives u a chance to navigate challenges and earn NFT as skins.
description:
This project is an interactive blockchain-based game that combines the thrill of a classic arcade-style experience with the innovative features of blockchain technology. Built using React, the game allows players to control an in-game character, navigate obstacles, and rack up scores. What makes this game stand out is its integration with both Ethereum and Flow networks, as well as the unique Nouns-inspired art style, providing players with the ability to collect NFTs, mint tokens, and benefit from enhanced security through the Venn Firewall as they progress.

The game starts by connecting a crypto wallet, such as MetaMask for Ethereum or Blocto for Flow, allowing players to authenticate their identity securely, with added protection from the Venn Firewall. Once connected, players can select a Nouns-style NFT from their existing collection to represent their in-game character, adding a distinctive and playful aesthetic to the gameplay. As they play, they navigate through increasing levels of difficulty, avoiding obstacles and earning points for their performance.

Upon reaching certain milestones, players are rewarded with tokens that can be minted directly through the game’s smart contracts. Players also have the chance to redeem these tokens for exclusive NFTs, adding a new layer of motivation and reward. The game integrates ERC-20 and ERC-721 contracts, enabling seamless token minting and NFT interaction, making it a perfect blend of gaming and blockchain collectibles.

The core objective is to deliver a fun, engaging gaming experience that leverages blockchain technology to reward players in a meaningful way. Whether you're a gaming enthusiast looking for an extra layer of fun or a blockchain fan interested in NFT mechanics, this game offers something for everyone. It combines skill-based gameplay, digital collectibles, and real blockchain rewards into one cohesive experience.
how_its_made: This project uses modern web technologies and blockchain integration. The frontend is built with React  and TypeScript, using styled-components for UI. ethers.js manages Ethereum interactions and connects to Flow, with MetaMask and Blocto Wallet for wallet access. Dynamic enables us to deploy the game on telegram and log in with metamask. Venn Firewall through txns ensures secure blockchain interactions. The game features Nouns-inspired pixel art, appealing to NFT enthusiasts. Smart contracts are developed with **Solidity**  for token minting and rewards. Game difficulty scales dynamically based on blockchain events, creating an engaging and responsive experience.
